name: Ninohe (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ninohe city emblem in red: a stylised chevron above a semicircle, forming a hexagonal device.
history: Municipal flag of Ninohe, a city in Iwate Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 January 2006.

features.role: Ninohe city emblem — a stylised chevron above a semicircle, forming a hexagonal device
